## 0. One-line pitch (remember this)

> **KWB** is an offline industrial **workbench** (not a chatbot): scan → HITL → cited DRAFT **Word** + sandbox-verified code/calc, with **task-routed open-weight models**, **grants**, and **Monitor A evidence pack** (start-stop snapshot — not CERT) on mid-range GPU.

---

## 1. What we provide (clear offer)

| We provide | We do **not** provide |
|---|---|
| On-prem agentic **workbench** for knowledge workers | A new foundation model |
| Pluggable open-weight models via local `/v1` + Model Cards | Cloud OpenAI / Claude / Copilot as the brain |
| Auto-select ≥2 task types (floor: single-tag adopt OK; full: two `model_id`s when staged) | Dual 70B in VRAM theatre |
| Scan → OCR/VLM → H1 → DRAFT **Word** approval note | Chat transcript as the product |
| Code + **sandbox** verify (network-none; calc-in-jail) | Docker Desktop lock-in / E2B cloud jail |
| Authz-first local KB + honest citations / `NOT FOUND` | “Indexed the plant” without ACL |
| Task **grants** + HITL (human ultimate verifier) | Autonomous safety / FFS / statutory decisions |
| Gateway-only path + Monitors A/B (Monitor A evidence pack — not CERT) | CERT-In / DPDP **certification badge** |
| Same architecture org→demo (REAL/MOCK/LATER honesty) | Live SAP/Maximo/DCS write |

## 2. Why this solution is best (for *this* PS)

Screeners fear “ChatGPT with a skin.” Uniqueness = **PS owner constraints**, not “we use AI.”

| Edge | Why it wins screening | Proof on PDF / demo |
|---|---|---|
| **Air-gap by design** | P&IDs must not leave | Gateway deny + Monitor A evidence pack (start-stop — not CERT) |
| **Artefact, not chat** | Expected Solution = Word path | `.docx` DRAFT + HITL |
| **Auto-select real** | Expected Solution ≥2 task types | Floor: single-tag adopt OK; full: ≥2 `model_id`s if staged offline (G1) |
| **Sandbox verify** | Expected Solution run+verify | Jail ≠ GPU; calc/code evidence (G3) |
| **Human verifier** | Hallucinated approvals kill trust | H1→H2→H3; DRAFT badge |
| **Pluggable models** | Space moves fast; mid-GPU OK | Model Cards; sequential load |
| **vs local chat UIs** | Open WebUI already exists | Grants + gates + Word + jail + router |
| **Integration > new LLM** | Defensible novelty | System loop, not a paper model |

**One sentence difference:** others give *chat, infra, or coding agents*; we give *PSU inspection artefacts + cited numbers + visible sovereign proof* on mid-range GPU.

### Slide 2 — Idea → chrome title = `[PRODUCT_NAME]`

**Layout:** left four blocks · right **one** core loop.

#### A. Proposed Solution

- `[PRODUCT_NAME]` = **fully offline Knowledge Work Bench** for industrial knowledge work.  
- **Not a chatbot. Not a new LLM.**  
- Delivers **DRAFT Word (`.docx`)** from scans + **sandbox-verified** code/calc.  
- Models = **pluggable open-weight** on separate runtime (`/v1`); workbench = OpenAI-shape **client**.  
- Sovereign proof = **Monitor A evidence pack** (start-stop snapshot of public destinations — **not CERT**).

#### B. Detailed explanation (how — keep this block)

```
Session ≠ grant → Orchestrator (software brain)
  → Ingest OCR/VLM → H1 verify extract
  → Authz-first retrieve (k≤5) + claims
  → Packer → Gateway (only path) → Runtime /v1
  → Tools / sandbox (network-none) / MCP local
  → Output gates → Template Word DRAFT
  → HITL H2/H9/H3 → Audit + lineage
```

- **Auto-select:** task → Model Card; mid-GPU = **load one at a time**; G1 floor = single-tag adopt OK; full = **two model ids** when 2nd chat staged offline.  
- **Org same boxes:** live read-only connectors + more cards — **never** write DCS/EAM/ERP.

#### C. How it addresses the problem

| PS pain | Mechanism |
|---|---|
| Cloud Claude/Codex forbidden; people paste anyway | Nothing leaves; egress evidence |
| Manual assemble of inspection packs | Cut find/type → **DRAFT in hours (estimate)**; judgement stays human |
| Locked to one model | Model Cards + local `/v1` catalog |
| Need agent + real files | Skills + sandbox + **docx**, not chat bubble |
| Mid-range GPU / no 120B | Sequential 7B-class quant (PS allows) |

#### D. Uniqueness (exactly 3 ticks)

1. **vs ChatGPT / Copilot / Claude:** air-gap + audit + grants; they cannot take P&IDs.  
2. **vs Open WebUI / Ollama / PrivateGPT:** we add **task router + HITL gate + sandbox verify + template Word**.  
3. **vs OpenHands / Continue:** coding agents; we are an **inspection-document workbench** that *also* has a jail — **patterns borrowed, not forked**.

**Right-side loop (draw):**

`Scan → OCR/VLM → Grant+Orch → /v1 (1 model)`  
`→ HITL → Sandbox (calc/code) → Word DRAFT`  
`Monitor A evidence pack (not CERT)`

No fake UI shot. No URL unless it loads.

### Slide 3 — Technical approach

#### Technologies (Layer / Tech / Purpose) — brands = **candidates**

| Layer | Tech (candidate) | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Workbench | Python · FastAPI *(hypothesis)* | Grants, orch, HITL, gates, audit |
| Gateway | OpenAI-compat client → local `/v1` only | Schema/card/grant verify; **only** socket to runtime |
| Runtime | llama.cpp **or** vLLM **or** Ollama **/v1** | Serve open-weight; quant; LRU; GPU probe |
| Model policy | Model Cards catalog | Pluggable ids; vision/OCR kinds |
| Ingest | Tesseract / PaddleOCR ± VLM card | Pre-LLM extract → H1 |
| Retrieve | Lexical/MOCK must; hybrid later | Authz-first; k=5; citations |
| Files | **python-docx** | Word DRAFT (must). Excel = LATER |
| Jail | Podman/Docker `--network=none` **or** non-Docker jail | Verify code/calc; **≠ GPU**; de-Docker |
| MCP | Local stdio host | Allowlisted tools; egress deny |
| Proof | Audit log + Monitor A/B | Reconstruct + Monitor A evidence pack (not CERT) |

**Hardware line:** Workstation/server mid-range GPU; smaller/quant OK. Demo may GPU+CPU; org GPU-only.

**Mandatory wording:** *Multiple open-weight **roles**; auto-pick by task; on mid-GPU **load one at a time**; G1 floor = single-tag adopt OK; full = two ids in the log when staged.*

**Do not:** Flask+Django+FastAPI salad · lock one serving brand · claim Excel/PPT must · wrap GPU in jail.

#### Methodology diagram

Same as slide-2 loop + callout: **Workbench ≠ Runtime ≠ Sandbox**.

### Slide 4 — Feasibility and viability

#### Feasibility (3 facts)

1. **PS allows** smaller models when 120B hardware absent.  
2. **36h / P1 = one spine** (G1–G10), not live SAP. Public sample scans OK.  
3. **Viability:** OSS + existing GPU; scale = more GPUs behind **same** `/v1` socket + Model Cards + USB offline update.

#### REAL / MOCK / LATER (36h honesty)

| | REAL (demo spine) | MOCK | LATER |
|---|---|---|---|
| OCR/VLM → H1 → Word DRAFT | Y | | |
| ≥2 task types (G1 floor / full) | Y (sequential; floor single-tag OK) | | Dual-load VRAM |
| Sandbox code + calc-in-jail | Y | | |
| Monitor A evidence pack | Y (start-stop snapshot — not CERT) | | Continuous A |
| Authz retrieve + citations | Y on local packs | | Live EAM/DMS APIs |
| MCP | | 1 allowlisted server | Full lifecycle |
| Excel / PPT artefacts | | | Y (Description overhang) |
| SSO / SIEM / SHA USB | | | Y |
| Write DCS/SIS/EAM | **Never** | | **Never** |

#### Challenges | Risk | Mitigation

| Challenge | Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| Mid-GPU VRAM | Dual-load theatre | Sequential load; G1 floor single-tag OK / full two ids if staged |
| LLM invents mm / CR | Bad engineering number | Schema + HITL; **math only in jail** |
| Bad scan / handwriting | Invented readings | Confidence; `NOT FOUND`; fail closed |
| Jail on Windows venue | Missing sandbox | Podman/Docker **or** non-Docker jail (de-Docker) |
| “Air-gap” that pulls weights | WAN on first run | Pre-stage weights (USB); unplug; host log |
| Trust in DRAFT | Shadow approval | DRAFT badge; human ultimate verifier |
| Overbuild vs SIH | Org forever, no demo | **G1–G10 spine first**; rest MOCK/LATER |

### Slide 5 — Impact and benefits

#### Target audience

| Who | What changes |
|---|---|
| **Primary:** inspection / integrity engineer | DRAFT Word from scan; **they** approve |
| **Secondary:** process, HSE, maintenance, IT security | Same workbench; more skills later |
| **Org (MRPL-class):** 15 MMTPA CPSE · ~2,530 staff | Stop shadow paste of P&IDs; reuse mid-range GPU |
| **Replication:** other PSUs / defence-linked plants | Same socket; different templates |

#### Benefits (one line each)

- **Social:** Cut shadow AI on confidential drawings (Cisco **48%** paste non-public — survey, not MRPL).  
- **Economic:** Cut elapsed **find-and-type**, not headcount; reuse GPU already bought. **No ₹crore claim.**  
- **Environmental:** No extra **training** run; **no cloud round-trip of P&IDs** (do **not** claim greener than cloud).  
- **Policy (one line):** On-prem prompts/logs (DPDP-*shaped*) + 180-day ICT logs (CERT-In-*shaped*) — **not** a legal opinion.

#### KPI (print exactly one)

**A — Time (preferred):**  
Scanned inspection pack today **1–5 days** elapsed → **target 2–3 hours to a DRAFT**  
*(industry workflow study — **estimate, not an MRPL SLA**; human still approves; not FFS/shutdown).*
